title: Snapchat: Build a Filter with AI in Just One Sentence! 👻
body: Snapchat: Build a Filter with AI in Just One Sentence! 👻

On November 18, Snapchat announced new AI tools for developers and advertisers. The standout is Easy Lens CLI, which lets any developer build a Lens — an augmented-reality filter that changes your face or adds 3D objects to the world around you — simply by describing it in one sentence to an AI coding assistant like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, and the assistant builds, tests, and publishes it.

It also launched the AI-powered Snap Creator Network to connect brands with the best-suited creators for their ads — now in open beta — and the Visited By feature, which lets creators highlight places they have visited on the Snap Map, available worldwide now.
What would be the first filter you build if it only took one sentence? 🎨
